findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler does not implement abstract methods of StatefulDetectorHandler
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed to subclass `StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate]` with `pass`, removing its previous `evaluate` stub without implementing `StatefulDetectorHandler`'s abstract methods (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Because `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` is set to `MetricAlertDetectorHandler`, accessing `detector.detector_handler` (in `Detector.detector_handler`, which calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`) for any detector of type `metric_alert_fire` will now raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` instead of returning a working handler instance.
